errors.message:
Streamable HTTP error: Error POSTing to endpoint: Databakkes is free with an account, and this request has none.
In an AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT): add this address as a connector and sign in when it asks; that creates the account.
In a script: sign up at https://databakkes.be/developers, copy your API key there and send it as Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY.
